body.x: MICRO DISPLAY(www.emicrodisplay.co.kr), an exhibit support company of Daegu MobileConvergence Center, unveiled digital signage display at '2013 International Consumer Electronics Show(hear after 'CES 2013') held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11.

As commercial large-screen LCD display, the 47-inch digital signage display of MICRO DISPLAY provides PC, tablet PC, Wi-Fi, RS232 control, Web camera, high-brightness solar solutions, impressive professional screen performance and digital signal functions as well as advanced design.
Equipped with HDMI, D-Sub, DVI, it provides USB input Media Player of industrial DID panel with full HD resolution. In addition, its Wi-Fi speaker provides a variety of display settings.

It has main option solutions, such as IR multi-touch, Embedded PC(Windows 7), Android Mini PC, Wi-Fi wireless data communications, web camera, high-quality solutions. Its main features are full-HD industrial DID panel, a protective glass, Ethernet and Wi-Fi or 3G/4G connection, a variety of VESA mount size, Wi-Fi speaker and line-level audio input / output functions.
It is usually used in airports, train stations, hotels, hospitals, shopping malls, schools, quick service restaurant, gymnasium, meeting room and train facilities.

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project 'New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
